Floss Pick 101

Made with input from our community of 40,000+ dental professionals, the BURST Adult Floss Pick is a 2-in-1 tool designed for a deeper, more convenient clean, anytime, anywhere. Featuring uniquely black floss to show what you remove and a soft silicone pick for gentle precision, it’s an easy, on-the-go upgrade to your flossing routine or the perfect companion to your traditional floss.

 Benefits

A better way to clean, anywhereA 2-in-1 multi-tool that combines floss and an interdental pick for a complete clean in one simple step—no sink required.


See the clean: Black floss provides instant, satisfying visual proof of plaque and debris removal—so you know it’s working.

Gentle, effective precision: Soft silicone pick flexes to remove debris while being gentle on gums—no sharp plastic.

Freshen + protect: Xylitol-coated floss helps support cavity protection while mint eucalyptus leaves your mouth feeling fresh.


Made for real life: Ergonomic, angled handle makes it easy to reach back molars at home or on the go.


 Features

Our dental professionals helped design a smarter interdental tool that works with your routine—not against it.
What makes it special?

 Dual-action design combines floss + pick in one tool
 Black floss for visible results and motivation
Soft, flexible silicone pick for gentle cleaning
Ergonomic angled handle for easy reach
Xylitol coating helps support cavity protection

Mindful ingredients: Mint oil and xylitol
You get
You get: 

90 single-use floss picks
Dual-action clean (floss + pick)
Portable, grab-and-go convenience

What you don’t get: 

Parabens (yuck)
Phthalates (double yuck)
Teflon
BPA
Major allergens 
Artificial sweeteners, flavors or colors 

 How to Dispose Responsibly: 
Remove the floss and soft pick from the handle before disposing of each piece separately.
